plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2025-2026 American Baptist College catalog, 'DEGREE AUDIT SHEET for MUSIC and ARTS ASSOCIATE'S DEGREE' (20 courses x 3 credits = 60 credits). The 2025-2026 catalog is used because the 2026-2027 catalog's music audit sheet replaces the Year One Spring concentration course with THG 1020, printing only 5 concentration slots against the catalog's own 6-course (18-hour) concentration requirement; the 2025-2026 sheet's 6 concentration slots match the requirement. The Year One Spring math row prints 'MAT 1020 - College Algebra (or other approved MAT course)/GS 205 Financial Literacy' and is transcribed as a choice between MAT 1020 College Algebra and GS 205 Financial Literacy. The option-level prereq inside the concentration list (CMU 1030 Music Theory II requires CMU 1020) is carried in the choice_note text, not as a machine prereq. The catalog's course-description header states 'Prerequisite to all Bible Courses is BST 1010'; the audit-sheet sequence places BST 1010 (Year One, Spring) before all other Bible courses, so it is documented here rather than repeated as a machine prereq. All ABC courses are 3 credit hours; total_credits equals the sum of ALL semester course credits including choice slots. transfer_confidence is 'core_only': ABC is a private four-year college with no published TCCNS/articulation equivalencies for these courses, so tccns mirrors the local course code.
